3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: On entering the building, we were met by a parliamentary guide who briefed us about the procedures. After a strict security screening, the staff ushered us to the third floor.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I, Deivid Wisci and the rest of the Sordish delegation to the Alliance of Nations arrived in Kyrute. The local police escorted us to the Alliance's headquarters in downtown Konstantium, immediately recognizable by its shining dome.
4.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Signed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.LateGameCrisis"] <= 2) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn09_StrongWomensRights_Signed"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.LateGameCrisis"] <= 2) == false)

5.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
5.text: "Mr. President, it is my pleasure to return to this podium."

6.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
6.text: "When I last spoke here, the message I gave was of encouragement and support to this organization and the vital role it plays."

7.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
7.text: "Of all the challenges Eastern Merkopa and the whole world has faced since then, one has grown larger and more imminent than any other."

8.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
8.text: "The threat of the so-called 'socialist' states and the actions taken by their authoritarian rulers with no regard to international law."

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: A loud noise came from the table of Valgsland. I saw Emmerich Hegel pounding his fists on his table in protest.

10.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
10.text: "...Today, the need to come together as the leaders of the free world is more important than ever."

11.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
11.text: "The CSP, under the leadership of United Contana, has been fuelling Valgsland's military-industrial complex and its expansionist aims in Eastern Merkopa."

15.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
15.text: "The world cannot turn a blind eye to the increasing naval presence of Valgsland in the Markian Sea."

16.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
16.text: "According to our intelligence reports, United Contana-made nuclear missiles were quickly deployed to the island."

17.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
17.text: "We demand that the Chancellor speak the truth. As you can all see, we have evidence of the construction of silos."

18.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
18.text: "We hereby call for the immediate dismantling and withdrawal of all missiles and other offensive weapons from Heljiland."

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: Emmerich Hegel stood up and kept pounding his fists.

20.speaker: Narrator
20.text: He pulled out a photograph. Even though it was hard to see from my position, I recognized it as an aerial image of Heljiland.

21.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
21.text: "We invite all the member states to support our call for a resolution in accordance with Article 11 of the Falenco Treaty."

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: A lot of noise came from the assembly hall in response. Most of the Western Merkopan delegates were clapping, while others either shouted in protest or sat in stony silence.

23.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
23.text: "We hereby call for the immediate withdrawal of all naval vessels with any offensive capability from international waters."

24.speaker: Deivid Wisci
24.text: "Let's see how crazy this year's session will get."

27.speaker: Player_Italic
27.text: Ignore Deivid and listen to Alvarez's speech.

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: Deivid leaned in and spoke in a low voice.

30.speaker: Player
30.text: "Look at that guy... He's an embarrassment."

31.speaker: Player
31.text: "Looks like the chancellor is already mad."

33.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
33.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true

34.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

35.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true

38.speaker: Narrator
38.text: The president of the assembly slammed his gavel down.

41.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
41.text: "No Eastern Merkopan nation can accept the installation of weapons of mass destruction in the middle of our Markian Sea!"

46.speaker: Deivid Wisci
46.text: "Honestly, this was always likely to happen. But so soon after the occupation? I didn't expect that."

47.speaker: Deivid Wisci
47.text: "If that's true, it's a threat to all of us. I didn't expect them to be so quick after their operation."

48.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
48.text: "Let us also not forget about the recent events that transpired in an another state with socialist teachings. A state that wages war against its own innocent citizens. Wehlen."

49.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
49.text: "We hereby call the member states to action against Wehlen and its Sordish 'caretakers'."

50.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
50.text: "Their purge of the minorities in their country was, again, largely ignored by the international community. I would go as far to call it a genocide."

51.speaker: Player
51.text: "That's a bunch of horseshit. Wehlen is not even socialist."

52.speaker: Player
52.text: "Right. Innocent citizens. He's forgetting the violence of the BFF."

58.speaker: Deivid Wisci
58.text: "Strictly speaking, Smolak's party is called the Wehzek Nationalist Party of Nurist *Socialism*..."

61.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
61.text: "Lespia was affected not only by the large wave of refugees coming from Wehlen, but by the subsequent government seizure of all of our companies that were active in the country."

65.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
65.text: "We hereby call the member states to action against Wehlen and its rogue government."

69.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
69.text: "Sordland violated our past treaties and gave support to this massacre with their armed forces, deploying them close to our borders."

70.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
70.text: "Wehlen violated our past treaties and mobilized their armed forces, deploying them close to our borders and authorizing them to partake in massacres."

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: He walked back to his seat amidst enthusiastic applause from most of the Merkopan delegates.

74.speaker: Player
74.text: "Honestly, that was not a bad speech."

83.speaker: Player_Italic
83.text: Pound your fist on the table in protest.

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: Deivid put a hand on my shoulder.

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: President Nines waited for the noise to calm down.

91.speaker: Narrator
91.text: Smolak stood up. As he walked past Patricio Alvarez, he brushed him aside with an exaggerated sweep of his arms.

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: When he reached the podium, he fumbled with the microphone for a few seconds. Then, he smiled at Alvarez mockingly as he raised the height of it.

95.speaker: Player
95.text: "I think the real chaos will start now."

96.speaker: Player_Italic
96.text: Stay silent and wait for Smolak to start speaking.

97.speaker: Narrator
97.text: Wiktor turned to President Nines and bowed slightly.

98.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
98.text: "The resources taken from these companies are being practically sold to Sordland."

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: He then turned back at us and stared out into the hall for a few seconds.

105.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
105.text: "It is true that the world today faces a multitude of challenges."

106.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
106.text: "In the midst of these challenges, the world's most powerful leaders gather here in Kyrute."

107.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
107.text: "And what do they do? They make threats. Promote hate and spread lies."

108.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
108.text: "Is this the Alliance of Nations we all want? Where is the cooperation and friendship? Where is the unity?"

109.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
109.text: "I want to remind you of the wars that the West fought on our soil... Of the foreign troops who occupied our country and seized our valuable resources."

110.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
110.text: "I want to remind you how they stole the oil from our sacred soil. And they did not know when to stop."

111.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
111.text: "The ATO soldiers left but their interference never ceased. They financed armed rebel groups whose only purpose is to create terror inside our country."

112.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
112.text: "So, fellow delegates! Don't you dare speak about Wehlen before you acknowledge your involvement in our civil war... Before you acknowledge your own dark past."

114.speaker: Player
114.text: "That's an empty argument. It doesn't justify what Wehlen did."

116.speaker: Deivid Wisci
116.text: "It's true that the western powers had their hands in the Wehlen Civil War, but it doesn't justify what they did to the Bludish."

120.speaker: Deivid Wisci
120.text: "It's true that the western powers had their hands in the Wehlen Civil War, but it doesn't justify the operation."

121.speaker: Deivid Wisci
121.text: "Sorry. You already know my take on dealing with him."

124.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
124.text: "As is well known, after the tremendous tragedy of the Wehlen Civil War, Arcasia made a deal with United Contana, where they agreed upon the withdrawal of their troops along with the removal of half of our army."

125.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
125.text: "Not only did they weaken us, we were left alone in facing the genocidal Bludish Freedom Front, which the ATO funds together with Rumburg."

129.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
129.text: "Just like the delegate before me, I will show you some of the evidence of foreign interference."

130.speaker: Narrator
130.text: He picked up a large stack of papers and waved them back and forth.

131.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
131.text: "I will show you some of the evidence of foreign interference."

132.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
132.text: "These documents will be published everywhere. Copies have already been sent to the Investigative Affairs of the Alliance of Nations."

133.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
133.text: "I have clear evidence of direct aid from Rumburg to the Bludish Freedom Front. They smuggled tons of KA-74s in Wehlen. They smuggled in their spies. Smuggled in mercenary commanders."

134.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
134.text: "I expect this organization to do its task and investigate this properly, instead of leaving Wehlen behind as they have always done."

135.speaker: Player
135.text: "He's finally talking about it. We're not the only ones now."

136.speaker: Player
136.text: "I should say something. Let Smolak know I'm on his side."

137.speaker: Player
137.text: "Should I speak up and support him?"

142.speaker: Deivid Wisci
142.text: "It's true we need as many allies as possible if we're to take on Rumburg."

143.speaker: Player
143.text: "He's got balls. Taking on Rumburg and the west like that."

145.speaker: Deivid Wisci
145.text: "But we can't be aggressive like Mr. Smolak here. We need the world powers with us, not against us."

146.speaker: Deivid Wisci
146.text: "After how much we've achieved with Rumburg?"

147.speaker: Deivid Wisci
147.text: "I thought we agreed on this. We don't want to create any conflict with Rumburg at this point."

149.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
149.text: "Coming back to the claims of the Lespian representative... First, there is no evidence of civilian massacres by the Wehzek forces, nor so-called purges of minorities."

150.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
150.text: "Third, we know your government is also implicated in the funding of the BFF. And that your oil companies aided their militants during the operation."

151.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
151.text: "Fourth, as the state, we only took what was ours. The companies the delegate spoke of were not only aiding militants, they were brought to Wehlen by force."

155.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
155.text: "And lastly, Wehlen has no *caretaker.* Wehlen only has friends whom it cooperates with."

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: Then he looked at the Arcasian delegates and the Lespians next to them.

157.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
157.text: "...And enemies who want to keep it down."

158.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
158.text: "Know that Wehlen will no longer recognize the right of any other country to determine what type of weapons we are permitted to possess or what type of policies we follow within our borders."

159.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
159.text: "Wehlen stands stronger and more united than ever. Our people have spoken. The enemies inside our borders are crushed."

160.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
160.text: "Now, I ask every delegate here to read our report on the connections of the West with the armed militants in Eastern Merkopa. And I ask the Alliance of Nations to do what's right."

161.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
161.text: "Wehlen only wants peace. Our people want peace. They are counting on the support and understanding of all the nations of the world."

163.speaker: Narrator
163.text: The assembly roared, with particularly loud applause coming from the seats of Rikan nations.

165.speaker: Player
165.text: "He seems to be popular with Rika, doesn't he?"

169.speaker: Player_Italic
169.text: Stand up and applaud his speech.

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: Next, President Nines invited Maartin Van Hoorten to the podium. He walked up to the microphone with quick steps.

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: Wiktor slowly walked back to his seat as he applauded himself. He saluted the Rikan delegates as he passed them.

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: He was frowning and clenching his fists. I could almost see his jaw trembling.

177.speaker: Player
177.text: "Seems like Maartin is not in the mood..."

180.speaker: Player_Italic
180.text: Stay silent and wait for Van Hoorten to start speaking.

184.speaker: Deivid Wisci
184.text: "Can you blame him? Valgsland has just occupied Heljiland."

188.speaker: Deivid Wisci
188.text: "Can you blame him? His navy is being harassed by Valgsland every day now."

189.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
189.text: "Mr. President. Fellow delegates of the Assembly, and friends."

190.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
190.text: "It is an honor to be with you today."

191.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
191.text: "I wish we could meet under different circumstances."

192.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
192.text: "Once again, the CSP nations -- and in particular Valgsland -- have shown us what they're willing to do to achieve their political aims."

199.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
199.text: "I must first thank the delegates from Sordland for being brave enough to recognize our Heljiland, when the rest of the world left us alone."

200.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
200.text: "I must sadly say that the world has left us alone."

204.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
204.text: "I must first thank the delegates from Sordland for being brave enough to support Agnolia, when the whole world left us alone."

205.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
205.text: "We were one of the first countries to propose proper cooperation among Eastern Merkopan nations."

206.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
206.text: "Yet when we were threatened by Valgslandian expansionism, nobody came to our side."

207.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
207.text: "Although Mr. Alvarez voiced his indirect support for us earlier in today's session, I can't keep myself from wondering where he was when our lands were under invasion by the very *socialists* he spoke about."

208.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
208.text: "Although Mr. Alvarez voiced his indirect support for us earlier in today's session, I can't keep myself from wondering where he was when our fleets were under attack by the very *socialists* he spoke about."

209.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
209.text: "So, here I am, asking for the support of the fellow member states of the Alliance of Nations. Agnolia is under attack by Valgsland."

210.speaker: Narrator
210.text: A loud banging noise emerged from the table of Valgslandian delegates. All of them were pounding their fists on their table.

212.speaker: Player
212.text: "Those delegates need to learn some respect."

213.speaker: Player_Italic
213.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true

215.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
215.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true

216.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
216.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true) == false

219.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
219.text: "Mr. President, please moderate the assembly. This is more than disrespectful."

220.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
220.text: "As you all know, Heljiland -- which had been a territory of Agnolia for more than three decades -- was invaded by Valgsland in a sudden attack."

224.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
224.text: "Not only did they unlawfully occupy our land, they brought nuclear missiles to the island the moment our forces retreated."

225.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
225.text: "As you all know, our drilling ships, oil tankers and even fishing vessels have been disappearing in the Markian Sea. Captured or sunk by Valgsland."

226.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
226.text: "And the Valgslandian fleet is patrolling the seas around Heljiland with complete disregard to international laws."

227.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
227.text: "Another state from Eastern Merkopa now works with the CSP. Malenyevist terror surrounds us on all sides."

231.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
231.text: "In the midst of all this, Sordland -- which explicitly promised to support us -- has switched sides after hosting a meeting with Mr. Malenyev."

232.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
232.text: "I call on the Alliance of Nations to find a resolution to this never-ending conflict that Valgsland created. We demand the immediate withdrawal of all naval forces from our territorial waters."

233.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
233.text: "Malenyevist terror surrounds us on all sides."
233.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_Agnolia_CancelledHeljilandRecognition"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance_Cancelled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true) == false)

237.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
237.text: "In the midst of all this conflict, Sordland gave United Contana docking rights in their largest naval base. That base currently holds an entire fleet from Contana."
237.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_Agnolia_CancelledHeljilandRecognition"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance_Cancelled"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true)

238.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
238.text: "With the access given to them by Sordland, the United Contana-Valgsland united force is now roaming our seas. Malenyevist terror surrounds us on all sides."

242.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
242.text: "We must not falter. I invite all member states to find a resolution in accordance with Article 11 of the Falenco Treaty, enforcing the immediate dismantling of all missiles from Heljiland."

243.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
243.text: "I must also remind you that under Article 3 of the Ventrie City Treaty, the Alliance of Nations *must* ensure the withdrawal of the occupying force from the island."

244.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
244.text: "I call the democratic world to action. Against the tyranny of Malenyevism, authoritarianism, militarism and extremism."

245.speaker: Narrator
245.text: The banging noise started again. Hegel stood up and approached the rostrum.

246.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
246.text: "You are a spineless jerk! A lackey of Arcasian imperialism!"

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: President Nines started hitting the gavel again.

251.speaker: Player_Italic
251.text: Speak up in support of Hegel.

253.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
253.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_HeljilandRecognised"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true

254.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
254.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_HeljilandRecognised"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true) == false

255.speaker: Player_Italic
255.text: Speak up in support of Van Hoorten.
255.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_HeljilandRecognised"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true) == false

256.speaker: Player
256.text: "Mr. President! Chancellor Hegel has the right to intervene. Let him respond."

259.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
259.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_Agnolia_CancelledHeljilandRecognition"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance_Cancelled"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true

260.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
260.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_Agnolia_CancelledHeljilandRecognition"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance_Cancelled"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true) == false

264.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
264.text: "In the midst of all this conflict, Sordland gave its support to Valgsland and even aided their fleet with the invasion."
264.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_Agnolia_CancelledHeljilandRecognition"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance_Cancelled"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true)

265.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
265.text: "With the intelligence and supply aid from Sordland, Valgsland's force is now roaming our seas. Malenyevist terror surrounds us on all sides."

266.speaker: Player
266.text: "You're blaming everyone for your own incompetence! Don't bring Sordland into this!"
266.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn09_Agnolia_CancelledHeljilandRecognition"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Agnolia_Alliance_Cancelled"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true

267.speaker: Player
267.text: "Mr. President! Point of order! 'The Chancellor' has no right to intervene."

269.speaker: Player
269.text: "Let him speak! What are you so afraid of that you won't even let him finish?"

270.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
270.text: "You have no right to intervene. Know your place, President Rayne!"

272.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
272.text: "All of your complaints against us are a direct result of your capitalist and neo-colonialist systems!"

273.speaker: Narrator
273.text: President Nines smacked his gavel in vain as a shouting match broke out in the assembly.

274.speaker: Narrator
274.text: Finally, after a few minutes, the other Valgslandian delegates convinced Hegel to sit back down.

275.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
275.text: "I believe I don't need to speak more about this subject. Everything is clear as day."

276.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
276.text: "Mr. Hegel's actions speak volumes about the reality of Valgsland and their corrupted ideology."

277.speaker: Maartin Van Hoorten
277.text: "I hope to see this conflict resolved with the help of the Alliance of Nations soon."

278.speaker: Narrator
278.text: He quickly left the podium and nodded to the other Agnolian delegate. The two left the assembly hall.

279.speaker: Narrator
279.text: Hegel immediately took his place and spoke in a low, seething tone.

283.speaker: Player
283.text: "Deivid, buckle up. It's the Chancellor's time now."

285.speaker: Deivid Wisci
285.text: "It looks like you're having fun, Mr. President."

287.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
287.text: "First of all, I want to extend a due welcome to the new states from Rika that have joined this organization."

288.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
288.text: "As our numbers grow and more states are represented in this stage, we come ever closer to finding resolutions to the conflicts that plague us."

289.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
289.text: "After fighting for years against colonialism and imperialism, they more than earned our membership vote. I am overjoyed to see them finally represented in this assembly."

290.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
290.text: "For hundreds of years, the dominant economies of Merkopa razed, pillaged and exploited the continents of Rika and Xina."

291.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
291.text: "Sadly, Valgsland was also a part of this plunder in the years before the revolution, when it still clung to the idea of imperialism."

292.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
292.text: "But when our masses found their voice, the old colonial powers and their new financiers turned against them."

293.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
293.text: "These powers did whatever they could to hamper our revolutions. They did not want the people to be heard."

294.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
294.text: "They are scared of us for showing the possibility of a better path. Of course they don't want us to succeed. We threaten the *productivity* that runs on the blood and sweat of their working class."

295.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
295.text: "And now they have started labelling us the aggressors. Yet we all know it was the Arcasians who built up military bases all around Merkopa. It was the ATO that was first formed to fight against Malenyevism."

308.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
308.text: "Heljiland was, is and will be Valgslandian territory. Our intervention in the island was completely justified."

309.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
309.text: "Other delegates brought up the Falenco and Ventrie City Treaties. However, they are forgetting about the Treaty of Adrium."

310.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
310.text: "Valgsland exercised its right to intervene on behalf of our people, who were being oppressed and massacred by the Agnolian government just because they did not recognize an appointed governor. They didn't get to elect one."

311.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
311.text: "We acted in full accordance with the second article of the treaty, If there's a side to be blamed, it is the state which murders its minorities for publicly showing support to our nation."

312.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
312.text: "There were also claims about illegal missiles."

313.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
313.text: "No country in the world has the right to determine what type of weapons we import."

314.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
314.text: "If there's a conflict the Alliance can resolve, let's start with the Arcasian base on Ravnos Island. Lespia has been housing Arcasian troops and missiles by our border for years and none of the member states even talked about it."

315.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
315.text: "The delegates from Lespia and Agnolia brought up the Falenco Treaty."

316.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
316.text: "Valgsland holds the right to protect its territorial waters and trade from threats."

317.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
317.text: "But what were they doing when ATO forces patrolled the Antacean Sea? They were silent."

318.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
318.text: "Just as no country in the world has the right to determine what type of naval vessels we use, no country can force us not to defend our seas."

319.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
319.text: "I also want the member states to look into the Arcasian bases in both Lespia and Sordland."

323.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
323.text: "I also want the member states to look into the Arcasian bases in Lespia."

324.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
324.text: "Perhaps then, there can be proper dialogue between our nations, and the Alliance of Nations can finally demonstrate that it can serve its intended purpose."

330.text: "And what about Heljiland? How about the Valgs being killed by the Agnolian government because they protested against an appointed governor?"

331.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
331.text: "Agnolia has no right to claim they are upholding liberty and democracy. And the ATO has no right to intervene in the matters between Agnolia and Valgsland."

334.text: "Most of that continent has still not achieved stability after gaining their independence from their colonial suzerains."

335.text: "It's easy to forget it has only been a few years since the revolutions."

336.text: "But unfortunately, the Alliance of Nations remains all too willing to overlook such human rights violations."

337.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
337.text: "And if the Alliance of Nations truly claims to have the people's best interests at heart, they cannot stay silent about what the Agnolian government did in Heljiland. How they took away the rights of our people..."

391.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
391.text: "Unlike many of the western countries here, we never received financial aid when natural disasters struck our lands."

392.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
392.text: "We always stood alone when embargoes and various unfair treaties were forced upon us."

397.text: "Not long ago, Sordland reinforced its forces along our borders."

398.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
398.text: "They took in traitors and gave them protection."

399.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

423.text: "They extended their hand in friendship. And now, I'd like to extend ours."

429.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
429.text: "Know this. Rumburg will do anything in its power to defend itself and its interests. Whether Sordland is actually planning something or not..."

430.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
430.text: "Before I finish, I also want to say..."

431.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
431.text: "Mr. Smolak. I'm looking forward to reading your report. I wonder what this so-called 'evidence' is all about."

432.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
432.text: "Know that your slander does not work on us. Know that we are ready to die for our freedom. Know that our kingdom stands firm and strong."

435.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
435.text: "If the Alliance continues to shirk its given duties, you can trust in Rumburg to take matters into her own hands."

568.text: "We cannot have world peace if we still have other nations who are not part of this organization."

570.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_ATO"] == false  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptArcasia"] == false

571.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
571.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptUnitedContana"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_ATO"] == false  or  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_SPAid_AcceptArcasia"] == false) == false

572.speaker: Player
572.text: "We cannot have peace if the AN allows rogue monarchies to pursue territorial expansion."

573.speaker: Player
573.text: "This organization cannot allow the dominant nations of this world to further arm themselves."

574.speaker: Player
574.text: "Today, the world stands more divided than ever. We cannot let this divide run deeper."

576.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
576.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_FPnT_Consulate_Condemn"] == false)  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn10_AN_BeatriceProposedSummit"] == true

577.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
577.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_FPnT_Consulate_Condemn"] == false)  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn10_AN_BeatriceProposedSummit"] == true) == false

578.speaker: Player
578.text: "I must thank Mrs. Livingston for her nice words."
578.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_FPnT_Consulate_Condemn"] == false)  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn10_AN_BeatriceProposedSummit"] == true

579.speaker: Player
579.text: "We look forward to increased cooperation between our two nations."
579.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_FPnT_Consulate_Condemn"] == false)  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn10_AN_BeatriceProposedSummit"] == true

580.speaker: Player
580.text: "Thank you for your proposal. I would certainly like to have a call with you on the topic of a peace summit."
580.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_FPnT_Consulate_Condemn"] == false)  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn10_AN_BeatriceProposedSummit"] == true

581.speaker: Player
581.text: "Sordland gave its all to have better relations with Rumburg. We can achieve a lot together."

582.speaker: Player
582.text: "I hope the reconciliation between two long-term rivals will be an example to the whole world."

583.speaker: Player
583.text: "As much as I appreciate the Queen's proposal, I must also say that we're still concerned about Rumburg's expansion of its military."

584.speaker: Player
584.text: "In any case, I am positive that we will put our problems behind us and look forward."

585.speaker: Player
585.text: "I hope to also see Mrs. Livingston listen to our concerns as much as we did."

586.speaker: Player
586.text: "Peace in Merkopa, peace in the world."

587.speaker: Player
587.text: "I will do anything in my power to show the world that peace and unity is possible. Even among old enemies."

588.speaker: Player
588.text: "Now I'd like to bring my speech to a close."

589.speaker: Player
589.text: "Now I'd like to talk about our duties as Alliance of Nations."

591.speaker: Player
591.text: "Sordland always wanted to have peace between our nations. Yet we are being threatened by Rumburg."
591.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_FPnT_Consulate_Condemn"] == false)  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn10_AN_BeatriceProposedSummit"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true) == false)

592.speaker: Player
592.text: "She talked about some hypothetical threat that our nation poses to Eastern Merkopa, while Rumburg's military has tripled in the last decade."
592.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_FPnT_Consulate_Condemn"] == false)  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn10_AN_BeatriceProposedSummit"] == true) == false

593.speaker: Player
593.text: "The real threat to Eastern Merkopa has always been Rumburg. Today, it's still the case."
593.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn09_RumburgPeaceSummit_StartTalks"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Turn02_FPnT_Consulate_Condemn"] == false)  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn10_AN_BeatriceProposedSummit"] == true) == false

598.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
598.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Retaliation"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Security_Unrest_Military"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_DeclareWar"] == true

599.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
599.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Retaliation"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Security_Unrest_Military"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_DeclareWar"] == true) == false

600.speaker: Player
600.text: "It was Rumburg who shot our aircraft within our airspace. We only defended our borders."
600.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Retaliation"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Security_Unrest_Military"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_DeclareWar"] == true

604.speaker: Player
604.text: "We wanted to be diplomatic even when Rumburg shot down our plane..."
604.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Retaliation"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Security_Unrest_Military"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_DeclareWar"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true)

605.speaker: Player
605.text: "The Rumburgian aircraft that was shot down was flying in our airspace."
605.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Retaliation"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Security_Unrest_Military"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_DeclareWar"] == true

606.speaker: Player
606.text: "It was a tragedy that both of our planes were shot down. We both made mistakes."
606.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Retaliation"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Security_Unrest_Military"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_DeclareWar"] == true

607.speaker: Player
607.text: "We will never recognize your vile words against us."
607.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Retaliation"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Security_Unrest_Military"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_DeclareWar"] == true) == false

608.speaker: Player
608.text: "I condemn your actions and your speech."
608.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Retaliation"] == true  or  (Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_Diplomacy"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Security_Unrest_Military"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.RumburgIncident_DeclareWar"] == true) == false

609.speaker: Player
609.text: "Sordland only wanted peace. Not baseless accusations and threats."

610.speaker: Player
610.text: "If Rumburg continues its aggression, Sordland will be ready."

611.speaker: Player
611.text: "I also have some evidence to show to the assembly. Mr. Smolak was right about the KA-74's."

612.speaker: Player
612.text: "Rumburg has definitively been arming the BFF in Sordland."

613.speaker: Player
613.text: "We discovered that many militant groups in Sordland were being financed or armed by Rumburg."

617.speaker: Player
617.text: "We discovered that the rebels both in Sordland and Wehlen were being financed and armed by Rumburg."

618.speaker: Player
618.text: "Let's come together, for a better tomorrow for all."

619.speaker: Player
619.text: "Let's come together, for unity between nations."

620.speaker: Player
620.text: "Let's work together to find resolutions to every conflict."

625.speaker: Player
625.text: "I hereby call on the Alliance of Nations to serve its duty. Rumburg and its links to rebel groups must be properly investigated."

626.speaker: Player
626.text: "I hereby declare Rumburg a dangerous threat to Sordland and Eastern Merkopa. Know that we will do what's necessary to counter that threat."

627.speaker: Player
627.text: "I hereby call on the Alliance of Nations to support Sordland. We are facing an existential threat."

628.speaker: Player
628.text: "Thank you for listening to our concerns. I wish to see a resolution from the AN soon."

629.speaker: Player
629.text: "Now I'd like to bring my speech to a close."

630.speaker: Player
630.text: "There is another important piece of evidence that we have. Provided to us by someone close to the Rumburgian government."

631.speaker: Player
631.text: "Mr. Hailstone was branded as a traitor in Rumburg for blowing the whistle on the country's hidden nuclear facilities."

632.speaker: Player
632.text: "According to our reports, Rumburg has been building its own nuclear weaponry."

636.speaker: Player
636.text: "I hereby call on the Alliance of Nations to serve its duty. Rumburg and its nuclear facilities must be properly investigated."

637.speaker: Player
637.text: "The AN can no longer fail to recognize the machinations of the enemies of peace."

638.speaker: Player
638.text: "We stand and always will stand, for the rights of the people of Sordland and Eastern Merkopa, just as those in other continents."

639.speaker: Player
639.text: "If the right actions are not taken, it will be quite evident that international relations cannot continue on such basis."

640.speaker: Player
640.text: "There cannot be any more procrastination or delay. The AN must adopt decisions according to the wishes of the people of the world."

641.speaker: Player
641.text: "The people of Sordland and I are honored to have expressed our concerns before this noble assembly."

642.speaker: Player
642.text: "Long live the Alliance of Nations. Long live unity and peace."

644.speaker: Player
644.text: "Now I'd like to bring my speech to a close."

653.speaker: Player
653.text: "Long live the democracies of the world!"

661.speaker: Narrator
661.text: Emmerich Hegel stood up and raised his fist.

666.speaker: Narrator
666.text: Patricio Alvarez stood up and started applauding.

668.speaker: Narrator
668.text: I heard thunderous applause from half of the assembly.

669.speaker: Narrator
669.text: I heard thunderous applause from half of the assembly.

670.text: There was some applause from the assembly.

671.speaker: Narrator
671.text: Emmerich Hegel stood up and raised his fist.

679.speaker: Narrator
679.text: I walked back to my seat. Deivid did not stop applauding until I sat down.

683.speaker: Deivid Wisci
683.text: "Well, it was not a bad speech. But we still have to hear from the heavyweights before the session ends."

684.speaker: Deivid Wisci
684.text: "It was not a bad speech, Mr. President. You did well."

685.speaker: Narrator
685.text: President Nines announced the next speaker: Dwight Walker.

688.speaker: Dwight Walker
688.text: "Mr. President, I first want to congratulate you on your election to this high office."

689.speaker: Dwight Walker
689.text: "Mr. Secretary, delegates to the Alliance of Nations, ladies and gentlemen, fellow friends..."

690.speaker: Dwight Walker
690.text: "We meet again on our quest to bring peace and light into this world. But even though some of the clouds have lifted, the world has not yet escaped the darkness."

691.speaker: Dwight Walker
691.text: "The Contanan Security Pact is rapidly expanding its influence. Now a fellow Merkopan nation, Sordland, is standing with United Contana and its Malenyevist ideology."

695.speaker: Dwight Walker
695.text: "The Contanan Security Pact is rapidly expanding its influence."

699.speaker: Dwight Walker
699.text: "It is very troubling to see a democratic nation of Merkopa be invaded by those Malenyevist powers."

700.speaker: Dwight Walker
700.text: "I refer, of course, to Heljiland's occupation by Valgsland."

701.speaker: Dwight Walker
701.text: "It is very troubling to see the democratic nations of Merkopa be threatened by those Malenyevist powers."

702.speaker: Dwight Walker
702.text: "I refer, of course, to the presence of Valgslandian and Contanan fleets in the Markian Sea. They are harassing other nations and hampering international trade."

703.speaker: Dwight Walker
703.text: "This is an attack against the lasting peace the world has enjoyed since the Century of Revolutions."

704.speaker: Dwight Walker
704.text: "Today, our peacekeeping obligations are being tested by United Contana and the Malenyevist bloc. If we fail to counter and stop this threat..."

705.speaker: Dwight Walker
705.text: "If we stay idle and allow them to build new walls and weapons of hostility..."

706.speaker: Dwight Walker
706.text: "If the attackers do not face any consequences..."

707.speaker: Dwight Walker
707.text: "We believe that all the people of the world must be free to choose their own future. No country, be it Arcasia or United Contana, has the right to impose its values on others."

708.speaker: Dwight Walker
708.text: "Then this unstable peace we believed we had built will be the world's downfall, and posterity will point its finger at us for not stopping it."

709.speaker: Dwight Walker
709.text: "Is this not an attack against world peace? An attack against the free-trading nations of the world?"

710.speaker: Dwight Walker
710.text: "Today, our obligations to world peace are being tested by United Contana and the Malenyevist bloc. If we fail to counter this threat..."

711.speaker: Dwight Walker
711.text: "If we stay idle and allow them to surround us with their war machines and blockades..."

712.speaker: Narrator
712.text: Emmerich Hegel and the other Valgslandian delegates started making noise again.

713.speaker: Narrator
713.text: This time, Hegel had taken off his shoe and was banging the table with it.

716.speaker: Player
716.text: "I have no words. The chancellor has gone mad."

717.speaker: Player_Italic
717.text: Pound your fists to give support to Hegel.
717.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true

720.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Valgsland_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_CSP"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_ComradeRayne"] == true) == false

721.speaker: Narrator
721.text: Despite the noise we all made, President Walker continued his speech without pause.

722.speaker: Narrator
722.text: Despite the noise Hegel made, President Walker continued his speech without pause.

724.speaker: Deivid Wisci
724.text: "He's not even ashamed. At his age."

725.speaker: Dwight Walker
725.text: "Despite its claims, the CSP's actions will only bring about war."

726.speaker: Dwight Walker
726.text: "But I will say this to the leaders of United Contana... If either of us is to be secure, we need a peaceful cooperation. Not defense systems, forced blockades or shows of naval superiority."

730.speaker: Dwight Walker
730.text: "Yet we still believe United Contana and Arcasia, together with their allies, can come to an understanding. For our mutual benefit and our desire to avoid the destruction of the world."

731.speaker: Dwight Walker
731.text: "We believed United Contana and Arcasia, together with their allies, could come to an understanding. For our mutual benefit and our desire to avoid the destruction of the world."

732.speaker: Dwight Walker
732.text: "Yet United Contana keeps acting in complete disregard to international law. Their allies are forcefully taking land and imposing their own values on the people of those lands."

733.speaker: Dwight Walker
733.text: "I will say this to the leaders of United Contana... If either of us is to be secure, we need a peaceful cooperation, not nuclear missiles, shows of naval superiority or invasions."

734.speaker: Dwight Walker
734.text: "If the leaders of United Contana fail to de-militarize Heljiland, with complete dismantling of the nuclear missiles and the withdrawal of the occupying Valgslandian forces..."

735.speaker: Dwight Walker
735.text: "The ATO will have to take matters into our own hands."

736.speaker: Narrator
736.text: Hegel stood up with the shoe in his hand.

737.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
737.text: "What is that supposed to mean? You're promoting war in the Alliance of Nations?"

740.speaker: Dwight Walker
740.text: "If the Alliance of Nations cannot find a resolution to this conflict, the ATO remains ready and able to react."

741.speaker: Dwight Walker
741.text: "Mr. Chancellor, please let me finish. We did not interrupt you when you addressed the assembly."

745.speaker: Dwight Walker
745.text: "I must also raise my concerns about the threat that Rumburg poses to Eastern Merkopa."

746.speaker: Dwight Walker
746.text: "The speakers who preceded me clearly showed that tensions are rising. The reports from Wehlen and Sordland are troubling."

749.speaker: Dwight Walker
749.text: "The representatives from both countries referred to KA-74s being smuggled within their borders."

756.speaker: Dwight Walker
756.text: "Mr. Rayne also pointed out the construction of nuclear weaponry in Rumburg. Our intelligence also confirms this."

757.speaker: Dwight Walker
757.text: "Arcasia and the ATO will stand against the aggression of Rumburg. They are playing a dangerous game. One that may bring ruin to Merkopa and their own lands."

758.speaker: Dwight Walker
758.text: "I believe the Alliance of Nations can find a resolution to this conflict as well. If not, let it be known that Arcasia will stand together with Sordland. Rumburg cannot do as it pleases."

759.speaker: Dwight Walker
759.text: "Finally, I propose that the Alliance of Nations undertake the noble cause of helping the people of the world through rewriting and properly enforcing its Human Rights Declaration."

760.speaker: Player
760.text: "Do you think Rumburg can pursue any more aggression after that statement?"

761.speaker: Player
761.text: "That's great news. I hope he means it."

764.speaker: Deivid Wisci
764.text: "I doubt that. With our membership in ATO and Arcasia's clear support... The Queen needs to be crazy to try anything."

765.speaker: Deivid Wisci
765.text: "This is definitely good news. Arcasia's showing clear support for us."

766.speaker: Dwight Walker
766.text: "The Alliance of Nations cannot survive as a static organization. Its size and duties are increasing enormously. It should adapt to the changing world."

767.speaker: Dwight Walker
767.text: "But peace and rights do not rest in the hands of this organization alone. They rely on the hearts of our people and the spirit of cooperation between our nations."

768.speaker: Dwight Walker
768.text: "So, let it be known, my fellow inhabitants of this world... Let us take our stand and see if we can finally achieve a lasting peace."

771.speaker: Player_Italic
771.text: Stand up and applaud his speech.

775.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Joined_ATO"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_CapitalistRayne"] == true) == false

776.speaker: Deivid Wisci
776.text: "That would be the destruction of the planet."

777.speaker: Narrator
777.text: The applause continued for some time. Walker shook hands with various delegates on his way back to his seat.

778.speaker: Narrator
778.text: Most of the assembly applauded his speech, the ATO delegates in particular.

779.speaker: Deivid Wisci
779.text: "Yes... I hope we won't be seeing a direct war between the superpowers any time soon..."

780.speaker: Player
780.text: "That speech had very dangerous connotations to it."

782.speaker: Narrator
782.text: President Nines spoke into the microphone once more.

783.speaker: Narrator
783.text: Malenyev slowly walked to the rostrum in his iconic suit. All of the CSP delegates stood up and applauded him.

785.speaker: Leon Malenyev
785.text: "Honorable chairman and fellow delegates to the Alliance of Nations."

786.speaker: Leon Malenyev
786.text: "Here we are again at the most esteemed meeting of state representatives in the world."

787.speaker: Leon Malenyev
787.text: "However, increasingly, we are being threatened, disregarded, attacked or ignored in this assembly."

788.speaker: Leon Malenyev
788.text: "The representative of Arcasia has just shown this unfriendly attitude towards us yet again."

789.speaker: Leon Malenyev
789.text: "Arcasia would have you believe we are standing in the way of lasting peace. Yet, the peace they talk about was only possible thanks to our missiles and our growing base in the developing world."

790.speaker: Leon Malenyev
790.text: "The ATO kept waging wars against people's revolutions and forcing new independent states to be their puppets. Binding them to themselves through the Arcasian Lira."

791.speaker: Leon Malenyev
791.text: "And now yet another Arcasian president is telling us that we are the aggressors and they are the keepers of peace."

792.speaker: Leon Malenyev
792.text: "We will not be silent anymore against these lies! When was this peace you talk about? Where was this cooperation between our countries? Have you ever accepted our invitation to talk about de-nuclearization?"

793.speaker: Leon Malenyev
793.text: "If you don't like us, don't accept our deals, don't listen to our concerns, and keep pointing fingers at us, why did you invite us to the Alliance of Nations?"

794.speaker: Leon Malenyev
794.text: "Every year, United Contana comes to this assembly to address the real problems of *real* people. People who suffer because of your systems, your wars and your ignorance."

795.speaker: Leon Malenyev
795.text: "Whether you like it or not, we'll keep representing the laborers, the slaves, the oppressed of this world. And believe it or disregard it, history is on our side."

796.speaker: Leon Malenyev
796.text: "We say to the representatives of capitalist countries... Come and visit us. Come and see the revolution working in Contana."

797.speaker: Leon Malenyev
797.text: "Show our continent to your people without distorting the reality. If you cannot do that, then you need not come."

798.speaker: Leon Malenyev
798.text: "We believe socialism will triumph over capitalism in the end. Such is the logical conclusion of the development of humankind."

799.speaker: Narrator
799.text: This time, the Lespian delegates started laughing very loudly. Some other delegates booed.

803.speaker: Player_Italic
803.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_ATO"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_CapitalistRayne"] == true

805.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
805.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_ATO"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_CapitalistRayne"] == true

806.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
806.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Lespia_Alliance"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Joined_ATO"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Archetype_CapitalistRayne"] == true) == false

812.speaker: Leon Malenyev
812.text: "You can keep laughing, gentlemen. Communism will bury you."

813.speaker: Leon Malenyev
813.text: "If you really believe in cooperation, we will be waiting! We're not going anywhere."

814.speaker: Narrator
814.text: Suddenly the laughing turned into shouting.

815.speaker: Leon Malenyev
815.text: "However, if the ATO keeps intervening in our matters... It is natural that the CSP would react."

819.speaker: Leon Malenyev
819.text: "Before we move on, we also would like to extend a warning to Rumburg."

820.speaker: Leon Malenyev
820.text: "The representatives from both Wehlen and Sordland referred to KA-74s being smuggled into their countries."

827.speaker: Leon Malenyev
827.text: "Mr. Rayne also pointed out the construction of nuclear weaponry in Rumburg. Our intelligence also confirms this."

828.speaker: Leon Malenyev
828.text: "United Contana and the CSP will stand against the aggression of Rumburg. They are playing a dangerous game. One that may bring ruin to Merkopa and their own lands."

829.speaker: Leon Malenyev
829.text: "I hope the Alliance of Nations can find a resolution to this conflict. If not, let it be known that United Contana will do whatever it takes to protect the people of Sordland and Eastern Merkopa."

830.speaker: Leon Malenyev
830.text: "Despite threats from the ATO, Rumburg or any other nation or organization, we must not succumb to further division and violence."

831.speaker: Player
831.text: "That's great news. I hope he means it."

832.speaker: Player
832.text: "Do you think Rumburg can pursue any more aggression after that statement?"

834.speaker: Deivid Wisci
834.text: "I doubt that. With our membership in CSP and Contana's clear support... The Queen needs to be crazy to try anything."

835.speaker: Deivid Wisci
835.text: "This is definitely good news. Contana's showing clear support for us."

837.speaker: Leon Malenyev
837.text: "We must ask ourselves, what do the people of our countries expect of us? They surely don't want war and bloodshed."

838.speaker: Leon Malenyev
838.text: "So let us leave to our children and grandchildren, good memories of our time and a better future for all. Let them look at history and say: once there were great divisions and complex problems, but the leaders of the world came together in the Alliance of Nations and succeeded in settling them in order to ensure our peaceful lives."

839.speaker: Leon Malenyev
839.text: "Let us act in such a way to make this session not a session of threats, but a session of hopes. And the realization of them."

840.speaker: Leon Malenyev
840.text: "The government of United Contana and the united peoples of Contana are ready to serve their duties for world peace."

847.speaker: Narrator
847.text: The assembly broke into massive applause.

849.speaker: Deivid Wisci
849.text: "I'm just very concerned about the rising tensions between them and Arcasia..."

915.speaker: Narrator
915.text: We entered the massive circular assembly hall and took our designated seats. Deivid sat next to me.

916.speaker: Narrator
916.text: After a short opening speech, President Nines called the first speaker to the floor.

917.speaker: Ephraim Nines
917.text: "It is my great pleasure to invite the Prime Minister of Lespia to address the assembly."

918.speaker: Narrator
918.text: Patricio Alvarez stood and walked up to the podium as the assembly applauded.

919.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
919.text: "In light of all that, I implore this Alliance to take a closer look at the actions of our southern neighbors."

920.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
920.text: "The world turned a blind eye when the armies of Valgsland occupied Heljiland. And they did not stop there."

921.speaker: Deivid Wisci
921.text: "All of the world's most powerful people under one gleaming dome."

922.speaker: Player
922.text: "One wrong word and the world will go to hell."

924.speaker: Player
924.text: "It's amazing how someone has managed to fill a room with people that absolutely loathe each other."

925.speaker: Deivid Wisci
925.text: "It is truly astounding. Humanity has come far."

929.speaker: Deivid Wisci
929.text: "How are you feeling, Anton? Ever since the assassination attempt, I'm amazed that you've been holding up so well."

930.speaker: Deivid Wisci
930.text: "High pressure, I know. Just believe in yourself, Anton. From what I have seen, you will do just fine."

932.speaker: Deivid Wisci
932.text: "But it must have been tough for Mrs. Rayne and the kids."

933.speaker: Player
933.text: "Still having nightmares about it. I just hope that whatever I decide, it won't put Monica and the children in front of the barrel of a gun."

934.speaker: Player
934.text: "It comes with the job. Monica and I already came to terms with the risk after the inauguration ball."

935.speaker: Deivid Wisci
935.text: "It is tough to be the president."

936.speaker: Player
936.text: "We knew changing Sordland would be hard. But we could never expect it to be this way."

937.speaker: Deivid Wisci
937.text: "Making harsh decisions and dealing with their consequences."

938.speaker: Deivid Wisci
938.text: "I wish I could have supported you more, but time has been a cruel mistress."

942.speaker: Deivid Wisci
942.text: "How are you feeling, Anton? Ever since what happened to Petr, I'm amazed that you've been holding up so well."

943.speaker: Deivid Wisci
943.text: "I remember how inseparable the two of you were in university. "

944.speaker: Player
944.text: "He was a true friend. I hope that he is in a better place now."

946.speaker: Player
946.text: "He was more of a friend to me than I ever was to him. I wish I had done more to help him."

947.speaker: Player
947.text: "That was before I knew who he really was. If I'd known, I never would have made him Vice President."

951.speaker: Deivid Wisci
951.text: "How are you feeling, Anton? Being the subject of so much media attention must take a toll on you and the family."

952.speaker: Player
952.text: "We knew changing Sordland would be hard. But we could never have expected it to be this way."

954.speaker: Deivid Wisci
954.text: "Well, the session is about to start. Let's get comfortable. It's going to be a long day."

956.speaker: Player
956.text: "It comes with the job. Monica and I already came to terms with the risk after the inauguration ball."

957.speaker: Player
957.text: "What you have done so far is more than enough. Don't treat yourself so harshly."

958.speaker: Player
958.text: "For what it's worth, I appreciate all the advice you've given me."

960.speaker: Narrator
960.text: From a distance, we could see the president of the general assembly, Mr. Nines, approaching his designated position.

962.speaker: Deivid Wisci
962.text: "Everyone's words and actions here will change the world, for better or worse."

1013.speaker: Player
1013.text: "If the AN truly wanted world peace it would arm itself and enforce such conditions. Where is your spine for God's sake!?"

1014.speaker: Player
1014.text: "Let's get our shit together and sort out this mess of a divided house once and for all or be swallowed by discord."

1034.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
1034.text: "Together with Wehzek forces, Sordish Armed Forces partook in massacres of innocent Bludish people."

1038.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
1038.text: "Sordland closed their borders to innocent Bludish people fleeing from being massacred by the Wehzek forces."

1039.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
1039.text: "They even supported and cooperated with Wehlen in their ethnic war against the Bludish people."

1040.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
1040.text: "And inside their country, they've been oppressing and killing innocent civilians -- just because they belong to a different culture."
1040.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.BFF_EliminationOperation_Botched"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_DefendBorder"] == true) == false)

1044.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
1044.text: "I wish to extend my support to Governor Ersen of Bludia, and all the Bludish people that has to go through tragic atrocities being committed by the Sordish authorities."

1045.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
1045.text: "Know that you are not alone. Millions are watching your brave fight for freedom. Rumburg is ready to support you."

1049.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
1049.text: "And inside their country, they've been targeting innocent civilians under the guise of fighting terrorism."

1050.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

1054.text: "And inside their country, they've been systematically pushing the Bludish people away from representation."

1059.text: "And inside their country, the Bludish people are rebelling against the oppressive rule of the Sordish government."

1071.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1071.text: "Gentlemen. I beg you to show some restraint."

1072.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1072.text: "The next speaker will be Wiktor Smolak, President of Wehlen."

1074.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
1074.text: "Order?! There will only be order when this coward stops smearing Valgsland's good name!"

1075.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1075.text: "Silence, Chancellor. Mr. Prime Minister, please continue."

1078.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1078.text: "The next speaker on the list is Emmerich Hegel of Valgsland."

1079.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1079.text: "Mr. Chancellor, I will remind you to respect the principles of civility and decorum in these halls."

1080.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1080.text: "Overruled, Mr. President. Please wait for Her Excellency to finish speaking."

1081.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1081.text: "This is not the forum for such arguments. President Rayne, please continue."

1083.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1083.text: "We have one final speaker before the break. Leon Malenyev of United Contana."

1084.speaker: Ephraim Nines
1084.text: "Thank you, ladies and gentlemen. We will reconvene later in the day for the final agenda items and closing remarks."

1085.speaker: Narrator
1085.text: Deivid stood and stretched his arms.

1089.speaker: Player
1089.text: "We paid reparations. What more does she want?"

1093.speaker: Player
1093.text: "I have indicated my willingness to forge a lasting peace with our northern neighbors. Yet Queen Beatrice insists on painting Sordland as the aggressor."
